_comment: Ceilings for everything a session loads BEFORE it does any work, in tokens
(rough: words x 1.3, tools/build_views.py:_approx_tokens). One registry so
no cap is declared twice -- registry-source-of-truth. Practice:
A ceiling is a watermark, not an endorsement: each was set at the measured
size when the surface was last reviewed, rounded up for headroom, so it can
be ratcheted DOWN by a reduction pass and never drifts up unnoticed. Raising
one is a decision somebody makes on purpose, in a commit, with the reason in
'why'. Never raise it to make a red check green.

AGENTS.md.why: First measurement. 9,501 of it is the gotchas section, which is working and is not to be trimmed for the number's sake; the reduction route is archiving what no longer bites, in full.

CLAUDE.md.why: An @AGENTS.md include. Anything more than a line or two here is content that belongs in the file it includes.

.precedent/SESSION_PRACTICES.md.why: Generated at session start from the team and individual sources, so it varies with what resolved; the ceiling is the whole of what those sources may add to every session here.
